question: MySQL/MariaDB + CockroachDB write oracle: does the INV-WRITE-SUBSET write-path differential (W1/W2/W4, W3 via arbiter) find leaks on these engines, which forms/denylist entries are needed, and can each engine be a golden adapter?
flips_if: leaks → extend denylist; adapters non-golden until 0 leaks

measured.hardware: laptop i9-14900HX, 32 threads; engines in Docker on 127.0.0.1 (grade B cap: laptop, not a VPS)

engines.mariadb: 11.8.9-MariaDB-ubu2404 (image mariadb:11.8, sha256:f16d7a34..., 103.9 MB compressed / 334.5 MB uncompressed, docker reports 329 MB)
engines.cockroachdb: CockroachDB CCL v25.4.18, start-single-node --insecure, in-memory store, default SERIALIZABLE (image cockroachdb/cockroach:latest-v25.4, sha256:bedee431..., 184.5 MB compressed / 464.3 MB uncompressed, docker reports 461 MB)
engines.mysql: NOT RUN: mysql:8.4 is 238.3 MB compressed / 829.2 MB uncompressed (> 500 MB limit); mysql:9.4 275.4 MB compressed

schemas: plain id PK, tenant utf8mb4_general_ci (U/D; upsert refused)
collated tenant en_u_ks_level2, id PK (U/D; upsert refused)

hardened_forms_differential.per_family: 300 cases x 4 seeds (1,2,3,20261025) = 1200 per family per schema; ≥300/family Phase-4 gate met

self_test.informational: pg-no-collate-c equivalent on CockroachDB (::text drops collated locale); crdb-reference-guard (oracle's postgres upsert guard verbatim) caught W1=3 on the collated-composite gate-demo schema

mariadb: guarded ODKU + RETURNING on composite PK under utf8mb4_bin (PAD SPACE): tenant 'acme ' arbitrates onto tenant 'acme' row; IF-guard prevents the write but RETURNING returns the foreign row (W4/W3)
PRIMARY KEY (tenant(3), id) even under utf8mb4_nopad_bin: tenant 'acmX' arbitrates onto 'acme' (guarded: W4 via RETURNING; unguarded: W1 overwrite)
PK(tenant,id) + UNIQUE(id): ODKU arbiter is ANY unique index -> tenant evil's row returned (guarded) or overwritten (unguarded) (W3/W4/W1)
PK(tenant,id) + UNIQUE(tenant,x): no foreign capture, but request for id 99 resolves onto own id 5 (arbiter != (t,id); E)
REPLACE INTO deletes tenant evil's row conflicting on UNIQUE(id) (W1)
sql_mode='' or INSERT IGNORE (even under STRICT): tenant 'acmeEVIL' truncated to 'acme' into varchar(4) (W2)
UPDATE ... RETURNING: syntax error 1064 on 11.8.9 (RETURNING exists only for INSERT/REPLACE/DELETE)
ODKU affected-rows 0/1/2 = unchanged/inserted/updated (existence signal; W6 note)
cockroachdb: UPSERT INTO on plain id PK: arbiter is always the primary key, no guard possible: tenant evil's row overwritten and re-tenanted (W1)

oracle's postgres guard `t.tenant = excluded.tenant COLLATE "C"` on a collated tenant column is evaluated case-insensitively on CockroachDB (left operand's collation wins): tenant 'ACME' overwrites tenant 'acme' (W1); `t.tenant::text = excluded.tenant::text COLLATE "C"` no-ops correctly
PK(tenant,id) + UNIQUE(id): ON CONFLICT (tenant,id) and UPSERT raise 23505 (fail-closed, no capture); arbiter-less ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING silently skips (existence signal)
SERIALIZABLE: 8 threads x 40 contended txns: 320 commits, 1830 x 40001 retries (max 58 attempts/txn), whole-txn retry gives exactly-once effects, 0 other errors

decision_effect.summary: Leaks found on both engines with non-hardened forms or gate-failing schemas -> denylist extended and engine-specific mandated forms added. With the forms and schema gate below, 0 leaks on 21600 executed cases: MariaDB and CockroachDB may be golden adapters (R2, W1/W2/W4/E). MySQL stays non-golden (not tested: image > 500 MB; MySQL also has no RETURNING at all).
decision_effect.W3_text_amendment (SPEC_INVARIANTS §E): W3 upsert/merge arbiter is exactly (t, key): the table's only unique index is (t, key); tenant and key columns compare byte-exact — binary AND NO PAD (MariaDB/MySQL *_bin are PAD SPACE and do not qualify; use VARBINARY or utf8mb4_nopad_bin), no prefix-length key part, no case-insensitive/nondeterministic/ICU-collated type; enforced by the schema gate from engine introspection.
decision_effect.F4 (crates/aegis-data-ir ir.rs): Collation::Binary doc: 'byte-wise, deterministic and NO PAD'; MariaDB/MySQL PAD SPACE *_bin (and any column with a prefix-length key part) map to a non-Binary collation (Nondeterministic, or a new PadSpace variant) so check_schema returns NonBinaryCollation; Schema needs the unique-index set (or an adapter-attested `only_unique_index_is_tenant_key: bool`) so check_schema can refuse Upsert on tables with any other unique index (new SchemaError::ExtraUniqueIndex).
denylist additions: MariaDB/MySQL: REPLACE (all forms), INSERT IGNORE / UPDATE IGNORE / DELETE IGNORE, INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE on any table whose unique-index set is not exactly {(t, key)}, multi-table UPDATE/DELETE, LOAD DATA

MariaDB/MySQL: sessions without sql_mode pinned (adapter sets SESSION sql_mode='STRICT_ALL_TABLES,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION,ERROR_FOR_DIVISION_BY_ZERO' on every connection and rejects SET sql_mode from modules)
MariaDB/MySQL: string atoms/guards compared under the column collation or a PAD SPACE *_bin collation (render CAST(c AS BINARY) <op> CAST(? AS BINARY))
CockroachDB: UPSERT statement (implicit primary-key arbiter, no guard)
CockroachDB: ON CONFLICT without an explicit arbiter list (any-unique-index DO NOTHING)
CockroachDB: the postgres-dialect upsert guard `t.tenant = excluded.tenant COLLATE "C"` (unsound under collated columns on CockroachDB); CockroachDB is its own dialect, not 'postgres'

mariadb: atoms: strings CAST(c AS BINARY) =/>=/<= CAST(? AS BINARY); prefix LEFT(CAST(c AS BINARY), <utf8 byte len>) = CAST(? AS BINARY); ints c = ? on int columns only; class mismatch -> FALSE; NULL column -> NULL (CASE WHEN c IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE .. END)

UPDATE .. SET .. WHERE lowerQ (no RETURNING exists); requested RETURNING emulated in the same transaction by SELECT <post-image projection, SET values as bound params> FROM t WHERE lowerQ FOR UPDATE immediately before the UPDATE (same lowered WHERE, incl. tenant)

upsert: INSERT .. VALUES .. ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE c = IF(CAST(t AS BINARY) = CAST(VALUES(t) AS BINARY), VALUES(c), c) RETURNING <permitted>, only behind the W3 schema gate (the guard alone is NOT sufficient: on a foreign arbiter match ODKU RETURNING still returns the foreign row)
upsert with no update columns: INSERT .. SELECT .. FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE CAST(t AS BINARY)=CAST(? AS BINARY) AND id=?) RETURNING .. (never INSERT IGNORE)
row_count / affected-rows not exposed to modules (W6)
cockroachdb: oracle postgres-dialect forms for UPDATE/DELETE/atoms unchanged (::text .. COLLATE "C" atoms are byte-exact on CockroachDB)

upsert: INSERT .. ON CONFLICT (t, key) DO UPDATE SET .. WHERE t.t::text = excluded.t::text COLLATE "C" RETURNING .. (cast both sides) behind the W3 schema gate; secondary unique conflicts raise 23505 (fail-closed)
SERIALIZABLE: adapter retries the whole transaction on SQLSTATE 40001 (bounded, e.g. ≤ 200 attempts / deadline), never partial replay; a retry-exhausted request fails uniformly (W6)

golden adapter.mariadb: yes, conditional on the forms + W3 schema gate above (0/10800)
golden adapter.cockroachdb: yes, conditional on the forms + W3 schema gate above (0/10800)
golden adapter.mysql: no (untested; inconclusive until an image ≤ 500 MB or a LAN box runs it)
